name: Narayana Hrudayalaya Ltd
title: Narayana Hrudayalaya Ltd - 539551 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 call: India margins up on case mix and high-end procedures, but UK acquisition dilutes consolidated margin (~20% reported, ~22% normalised) and greenfield capex delivered only INR 109 crore vs INR 424 crore plan.

capex.quote: The miss was due to a lot of the election -related issues in that it was impossible to get construction workers to come for a large amount of time.

triggers.label: Greenfield capex INR 109 cr vs 424 cr plan
triggers.quote: FY26 greenfield capex is only INR 109 crores against INR 424 crores planned

triggers.label: Volumes stagnated, ARPP growing
triggers.quote: Obviously, the volumes have stagnated, but because of the optimization of case mix and doing advanced procedure

triggers.label: Clinics losses persist into FY27
triggers.quote: you have to assume that a similar run rate of cash burn will continue on the clinics going into next year as well

triggers.label: Cayman insurance loss ratio 110-112%
triggers.quote: it's approximately about 110% to 112% is the loss ratio

guidance.metric: FY28/FY29 commissioning of Rajarhat, HSR, Raipur, Bangalore projects
guidance.quote: The FY '28 goal still remains the case

guidance.value: losses to decline over next 3 quarters
guidance.quote: we should start seeing these come down significantly over the next 3 quarters or so

prior_guidance_check.metric: Cayman insurance breakeven by Q1 FY27
prior_guidance_check.quote: maybe by Q1 FY 27, we might even reach breakeven

red_flags.label: Greenfield capex 74% miss
red_flags.quote: FY26 greenfield capex is only INR 109 crores against INR 424 crores planned

red_flags.label: Cayman insurance loss ratio 110-112%
red_flags.quote: it's approximately about 110% to 112% is the loss ratio

red_flags.label: UK reclassifications and non-like-for-like P&L
red_flags.quote: there are a lot of reclass items, Rajit

red_flags.label: Ex-UK doctor cost reclass ambiguity
red_flags.quote: we're not looking at apple -to-apple comparison in those numbers

evasions.topic: UK margin roadmap and synergy timeline
evasions.quote: It will take us some time to decide what are the relevant metrics to display
We don't specifically report out EBITDA margin for Cayman business
Again, we're not giving guidance, but we're trying to maintain the pace of growth in our business.
So, I would request you to refer to the transcript of that call
